rule: A readable poem shows exactly what its cited textbook page prints. These records were published before the textbook audit covered them (verification methods primaryPdfPageExtractionAndPixMapProof and primaryAndSecondaryPdfPageCollation) and their text had drifted from the cited page: another witness's wording, modernised spelling or punctuation. Each was compared with the page image (pdftoppm, 200-250 dpi); the text layer matched the image in every case. Applied with tool/literature/correct_to_page.py.
